result.reason: The clause substantially tracks the preferred structure, but the cap is calculated using all amounts paid or payable “hereunder,” rather than fees, and the 12-month lookback runs from the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself. That timing change was unnecessary and may materially alter the cap. In addition, indemnification is carved out only through an unexplained Section 8 cross-reference, so the operative language does not independently confirm the required indemnification carve-out. The other required carve-outs, mutuality, US$1 million floor, and fee-payment clarification are included.
